description: Source code for the icmsg_me module implementing inter-process communication messaging, including initialization, configuration, sending, and receiving data.

methods.name: icmsg_buffer_to_user_buffer
methods.description: Converts an icmsg buffer pointer to a user buffer pointer by offsetting HEADER_SIZE.

methods.name: icmsg_buffer_len_to_user_buffer_len
methods.description: Calculates user buffer length from icmsg buffer length by subtracting HEADER_SIZE.

methods.name: user_buffer_len_to_icmsg_buffer_len
methods.description: Calculates icmsg buffer length from user buffer length by adding HEADER_SIZE.

methods.name: set_ept_id_in_send_buffer
methods.description: Sets the endpoint ID in the send buffer.

methods.name: get_ept_cfg_index
methods.description: Retrieves index of endpoint configuration based on endpoint ID.
